subject: Pilot credits & burn-rate check — Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Green <olivia@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot credits & burn-rate check — Acme Analytics

Hi Olivia — great to meet the team on today's call. Quick recap and a few asks so we can finalize the pilot credits and telemetry setup: 

Recap:
- Pilot scope: integrate Redwood hosted API for chat generation (customer-facing assistants) + embeddings for search/ranking.
- Pilot length: proposed 2 weeks, goal to validate quality and unit economics.
- Next milestone: get initial integration sending sample traffic and ship telemetry/dashboard access.

Asks / data we need to size credits and confirm pricing: 
1) Expected volumes during pilot (rough ranges are fine): monthly generation tokens and monthly embeddings tokens you expect to send during pilot ramp and steady state.
2) Target budget range for the pilot (total $ you want to commit / test with).
3) Any target $/1M tokens (unit economics) you need us to hit to move to a committed pilot or reserved capacity?
4) Concurrency / latency SLOs you care about (e.g., median ≤ 300ms, p95 ≤ 1s).

We can approve one-off trial credits to cover the initial burn — if you share expected volumes and budget range I can propose a credits amount and extension criteria. I attached a one-line pilot estimate template to make the numbers quick: pilot_estimate_template.xlsx (file stub).

Proposed next steps:
- You send the rough volumes/budget back by EOD Monday
- Dev sends a short list of sample prompts (or we use your prod-like prompts) for the quality eval
- We provision a pilot key and $X credits on our side pending Rishi sign-off

Thanks — happy to jump on 15 min if it's easier to walk through.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales (West) | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: pilot_estimate_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Olivia Green <olivia@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme-analytics.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-03-01T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & burn-rate check — Acme Analytics

Thanks Marissa — good meeting on our side as well. Quick answers below: 

1) Rough volumes: during a 2-week pilot we expect roughly 5–10M generation tokens (mainly prompts+responses for 1 assistant) and ~500k–1M embedding tokens (50k vectors for testing). If we run a short stress test we could spike to 15–20M generation tokens in a peak week.
2) Budget: we'd like to keep the pilot under $10k total if possible.
3) Unit economics: we’re targeting something close to $200–$400 per 1M generation tokens to make this work vs. our current vendor. Embeddings are secondary but would prefer competitive per-1M pricing there as well.
4) Latency: target median ~250ms, p95 < 1s for our test queries — lower is better but we can tolerate some variance in the pilot.

We can attach a short prompt set and a sample conversation trace — I’ll have Tom share the prompt file (he's copied). Procurement copied for visibility on credits/PO flow.

Appreciate the estimate template — we’ll fill and return by EOD Monday.

— Olivia
Olivia Green
Head of Product | Acme Analytics
olivia@acme-analytics.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-03-01T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & burn-rate check — Acme Analytics

Marissa — thanks for the notes. Quick internal: based on their stated volumes and target unit economics, I'm comfortable approving an initial $10,000 trial credit to cover the first 2 weeks, with a clear extension policy:

- Approved credits: $10,000 (will be applied to Acme's hosted account).
- Target unit economics guidance for the commercial conversation: aim for ~$250 per 1M generation tokens (we can back into per-request price for their usage patterns).
- Extension policy: if they consume >50% of credits in the first week and the integration looks healthy, we can auto-approve a one-time extension of $5,000 pending CSM sign-off (no legal needed).

Dev — please provision a pilot key tied to Acme's account and set up the pilot_kpi_dashboard (Drive link below). Also enable the usage export for us so we can monitor token-level burn.

Attachment: approved-credits-memo.txt (internal stub)

Rishi
